text: I like Therese. I wouldn't have hurt her. Not ever.
Is that right? You two had a strange way of showing your affection.
Please, Detective. I need to know what happened to Therese.
A lot happened to Miss Banning, actually.
I guess the short version would be that someone strung her up and fried her in her very own blood.
Whoever he is, I swear to God, I'll get him
I'm sure the good people of the city will rest easier knowing that
